exposure: Programmed labour regime (pentazocine, drotaverine, diazepam, and tramadol)
outcome: Duration of first stage of labour
Duration of second stage of labour
Duration of third stage of labour
cohort: The study included 100 low-risk primiparas (50 in each group) with cervical dilatation of 3 to 4 cm.
finding: Programmed labour significantly reduced the duration of all stages of labour and resulted in milder pain compared to conventional labour, with minimal adverse effects like nausea.
